manifest: PDV 2.0 ORIGIN adapter split -- tranche t5 (Orc + Imperial)
duplicationNote: Lane functions were COPIED, not moved. The originals are still in PDV_OriginRuntimeBase.psc; a same-signature child function is simply an override, so the duplication compiles. A later central pass removes the originals using the copiedFunctions lists below.
verbatimProof: Each adapter's copied region was re-extracted from the adapter file and diffed against the exact PDV_OriginRuntimeBase line ranges it came from. Both diffs are empty, so the bodies are byte-identical and still reconstruct against origin_golden.json.

Orc.scriptVarNote: Checked per function, not per file: no Orc lane body reads or writes a bare script variable. The base declares none for Orc (its declared vars are Altmer/Bosmer, Khajiit, Dunmer and Nord only), and the single textual hit for '_activeDeity' inside the Orc range is a COMMENT in ApplyOrcInitialChoice, not a reference. Nothing had to move; nothing needs a base accessor pair.

virtualsNotOverridden.ApplyInitialChoice: SIGNATURE GAP. ApplyOrcInitialChoice(Int modeValue, String reason) needs the chosen life mode and a reason; the frozen virtual takes nothing. Needs a base-side carrier (the SetDawnHadActivity precedent) or a widened virtual before it can be delegated. Live caller today: PDV__ManagerQuest.psc:7550.
virtualsNotOverridden.ApplyCurseHandlers: SIGNATURE GAP. ApplyOrcCurseHandlers(Int oldState, Int newState, String reason); the frozen virtual takes nothing. Live caller today: PDV_DevotionLedger.psc:4254.
virtualsNotOverridden.IsOfferEligibleDeity: N/A for Orc. Malacath is the innate Orc spine (activated at origin), so there is no Orc offer lane; the base default False is correct.

virtualDelegationNotes.GetOriginStateValue: Delegates to GetActiveOrcRewardMode(), which is the life-mode track value clamped to CITY..LEGION_EXILE with CITY as the missing-track default.
virtualDelegationNotes.HandleLocationChange: BEHAVIOR DELTA TO REVIEW. HandleOrcLocationChange(Location newLocation) needs a Location the frozen virtual cannot carry, so the override reads Game.GetPlayer().GetCurrentLocation(). The live caller (PDV_ActionRouter.HandleStoryChangeLocation:320) passes akNewLocation. Equivalent in the normal Story-event path, but not provably identical -- a Location-typed carrier would close it.

providerOverride.bodyChangesWhen: the provider seam lands and GetOrcLifeModeGainMultiplier moves into this adapter
providerOverride.redundantGate: The 'GetPlayerOriginRaceIndex() != ORIGIN_ORC -> return 1.0' gate at the top of the manager function becomes redundant once this override is race-selected (one adapter per playthrough). It is DELIBERATELY LEFT IN PLACE by this tranche and must be removed with the seam, not before.
providerOverride.phaseEvidence: Both deferred multipliers are consumed only from PDV_DevotionLedger.ProcessDawn (lines 2029-2030), so phase 1 == AT_DAWN is the only live phase today.

Imperial.scriptVarNote: Checked per function, not per file: no Imperial lane body reads or writes a bare script variable. Nothing had to move; nothing needs a base accessor pair.
Imperial.namingCaveat: ApplyConcordatPressure, GetConcordatSummary, BuildImperialConcordatSurveySentence and FormatImperialConcordatLabel carry no 'Imperial' in the name but are Imperial-lane: ApplyConcordatPressure hard-gates on ORIGIN_IMPERIAL and the rest read PDV_ConcordatStandingTrack. The base separately keeps a GENERIC Concordat/Talos block (EnsureTalosRuntimeIdentity, HandleTalosBetrayal, GetTalosTrackGainMultiplier, ...) from tranche 6 -- that stays on the base and was NOT copied.

virtualsNotOverridden.ApplyInitialChoice: N/A. The Imperial lane has no initial-choice entry point (no ApplyImperialInitialChoice exists).
virtualsNotOverridden.EnsureRuntimeWiring: N/A. The Imperial lane has no Ensure* wiring function.
virtualsNotOverridden.ApplyCurseHandlers: SIGNATURE GAP. ApplyImperialCurseHandlers(Int oldState, Int newState, String reason); the frozen virtual takes nothing. Live caller today: PDV_DevotionLedger.psc:4252.
virtualsNotOverridden.GetFormalCommitmentOfferMessage: SIGNATURE AND RETURN-TYPE GAP. GetImperialFormalCommitmentOfferMessage(PDV_DeityBase deity) returns a Message record; the frozen virtual returns String and takes no deity. Live caller today: PDV_DevotionLedger.psc:3914, which needs the Message. This one needs an ADR amendment, not a workaround.
virtualsNotOverridden.ShowOriginNotification: N/A. No Imperial lane notification helper.

virtualDelegationNotes.GetOriginStateValue: Reads Manager.PDV_ConcordatStandingTrack.GetValue() (PDV_ReputationTrack.GetValue returns Int) with a None guard. There is no existing named Imperial getter for the raw standing value, so this is the one override that is not a pure delegation.

Imperial.notRoutedThroughSignals: ApplyImperialConcordatAction(String actionKey, String reason) takes a closed enum of 8 action keys and is called with an explicit key by the manager/router. Per the ADR the keyed verb collapses the Handle* family, so this stays a named adapter function rather than being fanned out into 8 synthetic signal ids.

providerOverride.bodyChangesWhen: the provider seam lands and GetImperialCurseGainMultiplier moves into this adapter
providerOverride.redundantGate: The 'OriginRuntime.GetPlayerOriginRaceIndex() != ORIGIN_IMPERIAL -> return 1.0' gate at the top of the manager function becomes redundant once this override is race-selected. It is DELIBERATELY LEFT IN PLACE by this tranche and must be removed with the seam, not before.

crossCuttingFindings.title: HandleContextualSignal drops the `String reason` every lane handler takes
crossCuttingFindings.detail: The frozen virtual is (String signalId, Form contextForm, Float magnitude). Every Orc and Imperial Handle* function takes a trailing `String reason` that is written into StorageUtil ('PDV.Orc.LastLifeModeReason', 'PDV.Orc.LastBrokenFaithKinReason', ...) and into Trace text. The dispatch substitutes the signalId for the reason. Behavior is preserved; the stored/traced reason STRING changes. This is exactly the dispatch-layer delta the ADR says parity cannot cover and that needs a hand behavior review. If reason fidelity matters, the virtual needs a fourth `String reason = ""` parameter -- an ADR amendment, not an adapter change.

crossCuttingFindings.title: Four frozen virtuals cannot carry their lane function's arguments
crossCuttingFindings.detail: ApplyInitialChoice (Orc: modeValue+reason), ApplyCurseHandlers (Orc and Imperial: oldState+newState+reason), HandleLocationChange (Orc: Location), GetFormalCommitmentOfferMessage (Imperial: takes PDV_DeityBase, returns Message not String). Three are left unoverridden and one (HandleLocationChange) is delegated with a current-location read. The central call-site remap cannot retire the named calls in PDV_DevotionLedger.psc:3914/4252/4254, PDV__ManagerQuest.psc:7550 and PDV_ActionRouter.psc:320 until the ADR interface is amended or base-side carriers are added.

crossCuttingFindings.title: `key` is a reserved form type in Papyrus
crossCuttingFindings.detail: The base declares GetOriginDetailLabel(String key) / GetOriginDetailValue(String key) and compiles only because its default bodies never touch the parameter. Any adapter that actually reads it fails with 'key is not a variable' (Key is a Skyrim MiscObject subtype). Both adapters here name the parameter `detailKey`. Overrides match on parameter TYPES, not names, so this is legal -- but every remaining adapter will hit it, and the base declaration should be renamed when it is next touched.

crossCuttingFindings.title: PDV_GainModifierProvider does not exist yet
crossCuttingFindings.detail: The ADR states `PDV_OriginRuntimeBase extends PDV_GainModifierProvider`. On this branch the base still `extends Quest` and there is no PDV_GainModifierProvider.psc. Both provider overrides here are plain virtual overrides of the base's own GetProviderGainMultiplier and are inert (identity 1.0 outside dawn) until the seam lands.
